Name: JP's Starter Stable
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][b][i][color=#00ff00][size=6][u]Starter Stable[/u][/size][/color][/i][/b][/font][/center]
[font=Georgia]

[b][i][color=#ff00ff][size=5]Because having to walk everywhere is something that not many people are willing to do... (Oguri Fatty Cap) WHO SAID THAT?! Come Here you...![/size][/color][/i][/b]

[/font]
[list]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia]This mod adds a stable next to your horse when starting a new game or in a saved game only if you don't have a stable yet. [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia]At the start of the day, a random location on the map that is not blocked by debris or other objects is chosen and the stable is placed there. You will then receive a message that it has been successfully placed. [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia]If no suitable location can be found, you will be told that it could not be placed and that you must clear an area so that the stable can be placed again the following day. [/font][/size][/*]
[/list]

[font=Georgia][b][size=4]There's not much else to say, it works on [color=#00ffff]custom maps[/color] and, due to the logic of the mod, it can appear in the strangest places, so you can always move the stable in Robin's store to a position that suits you better.[/size][/b]


[b][i][color=#00ff00][size=5]That's it, it's a simple mod with no settings, so GMCM won't be necessary in this case. As I said, the location is chosen at random, so you have no control over where it will appear beyond clearing a specific area if the stable still doesn't appear due to lack of space. [/size]
[/color][/i][/b]

[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.
